question: Does the degree-4 mutant closure W_4 of Nagao 2015/984 EQS4(m,R) instances at p = 2 (binary ordinary curve, disjoint non-zero coset factor bases, chained S_3 Weil descent with field equations, planted satisfiable R) contain a degree-compatible Groebner basis of the ideal on every instance of the frozen grid, as Proposition 5 with Assumption 1 predicts? A single certified instance with W_4 not containing the basis is a counterexample. Also: what is the least closure degree D_solve per instance?

claims.text: On the named instance(s), W_4(EQS4) does not contain a degree-compatible Groebner basis (Type-L: a linear form X_j + s_j is missing with |Z| = 1; Type-G: |Z| > 1, d_GB <= 4, closure deficit), certified by an ann-certificate that an independent checker accepts. So no degree-<=4 F4-type computation produces that basis, and Assumption 1 with d_F <= 4 fails at that instance.
claims.if_supported: Record evidence with proof_status certificate at the instance(s). The derived claim against Nagao's chain is held for review-breakthrough. Map the failing boundary.
claims.if_not_supported: No certified non-containment exists among completed decisive instances. Read CL-corroboration.

claims.text: Every decisive EQS4 and EQS4-U instance in the completed cells has the Groebner basis inside W_4, while the profile-matched null is not contained on at least 3 of 5 uniqueness-verified seeds in at least one completed cell with N >= 18. This is breakthrough-adjacent corroboration at tested scope only.
claims.if_supported: Record corroboration at tested scope, un-promoted pending review-breakthrough. No cost claim. Rank a larger-N successor.
claims.if_not_supported: If the null never discriminates, the outcome is inconclusive (the instrument never said no for the right reason).

claims.text: Descriptive only (design revision 2, DER-9): every EQS4 and EQS2 instance with m >= 3 has a degree-1 element in the span of its last-link coordinates, so d_F^eq <= 2 and the original premise (instances with d_F^eq = 3) is empty. The report is M-6 (expected 2 everywhere) with D_solve against 2 and against 3. It decides nothing and cannot contribute to the counterexample or corroboration claims.
claims.if_supported: Report the table of M-6 and of D_solve against 2 and 3 as a separate descriptive claim. It does not touch the O((nm)^{4w}) reading. A value of M-6 other than 2 is a builder or d_F-module defect to investigate first.
claims.if_not_supported: Report the table as a separate descriptive claim.

claims.text: Difference in D_solve between EQS4 and matched EQS2 (v = 0) at the same cell, seed, curve and V. Descriptive, read with |Z| as a covariate.
claims.if_supported: Report the matched-pair table as bearing on footnote 6 ('same as the Semaev's case').

claims.text: Any statement about a deployed or standardised curve, ECDLP security, cost or speedup, Nagao's asymptotic regime, n beyond the tested cells, odd characteristic, or solvers outside the linear-algebra closure model. Theorem 1 as a conditional statement is not refuted by any outcome.

hypotheses.statement: At least one EQS4 instance of the frozen grid has a degree-4 mutant closure W_4 that does not contain a degree-compatible Groebner basis of its ideal: a counterexample to Nagao 2015/984 Proposition 5 AND Assumption 1 at that instance. Falsified at tested scope if every decisive instance is contained and the null discriminates.
hypotheses.mechanism: The coset shifts change lower-degree terms of the descended S_3 links without changing their top forms. The chained closure degree is reported to rise at l = 7 for m = 3 (related lead). The alternative: the convolution-tensor degree-2 falls measured at m = 2 (KN-FIND-5a8d3e, KN-FIND-c3a917) survive shifts and chaining, and W_4 contains the basis at reachable scale.

arms.description: Nagao EQS4(m,R), Definition 8: chained S_3 links, X_i in V + v_i with v_i outside V and pairwise-disjoint cosets, Weil descent in the polynomial basis, reduced multilinear generators, Boolean ring (S_fe inside). Draw a=0 of (cell,r), unconditioned on |Z|.

EQS4 conditioned on |Z| = 1: the first of attempts a=0..31 with a unique F_2 solution. Attempt a=0 is the EQS4 stream (same instance as EQS4 when unique); attempt a>=1 uses arm EQS4-U, instance cell_id/a<a>. not_available if no attempt is unique. An attempt that cannot be planted counts as non-unique. Supplies Type-L certificates.

Matched unshifted system (all v_i = 0, Definition 4 with chained EQS1). Same curve, field, V and order as EQS4 at (cell,r). Planted from its own substream, not_available (not a result) when no valid decomposition exists within 20000 tries. Read by the general DER-3 criterion because |Z| >= 2 is typical (S_3 symmetric in X_1, X_2).

Random multilinear planted system matching the EQS4 instance's N, M and exact per-equation per-degree monomial counts (cubic links plus quadratic last link). Constants set so a uniform s is a solution. |Z| brute-forced where N <= 26, affine-subspace search from the W_4 linear forms otherwise (M-1 undetermined_Z_unknown when more than 16 variables stay free). Declared mismatch: its span has no degree-1 element, while every EQS4 span has one (DER-9).
The EQS4 instance's own monomial multiset per degree, permuted across equations, constants re-set to plant a uniform s. Run at N <= 26 only.
Triangular planted system (DER-6) at matched N and M, hidden by a random invertible affine variable map and an equation recombination. Provably contained in W_3, with |Z| = 1.

The EQS4 instance re-encoded by a random invertible affine change of variables and a random invertible equation recombination of the raw generators; the closure runs on the adapted generators (DC-9) of both. Exact metrics M-1, M-2, M-3, M-4 (iteration 0 included), M-5 and M-7 at every D must be identical (DER-8(c)).
The same EQS4 instance in the full ring F_2[X] with S_fe as explicit generators (C(N+4,4) columns at D=4), N <= 20. Checks DER-1. Agreement is structurally forced.
The same descended generators (the same adapted generators as EQS4-FULLFE) in the full ring without S_fe, N <= 20. Linear forms in W_D, whether 1 is in W_D, and d_F^eq (DER-7). Descriptive only.

positive.expected_detection: M-1 true and M-3 (D_solve) <= 3 on every PC-TRI instance at every cell run. Any miss stops the run as invalid (SR-4).

null_population.description: Random multilinear Boolean systems with a planted solution, profile-matched to each EQS4 instance
null_population.generator: code/nulls.py NULL-PROF: uniform supports with per-equation per-degree monomial counts copied from the EQS4 instance, coefficients 1 on support, constants set by a uniform planted s, from the arm seed substream
null_population.why_n: 5 seeds per cell (3 at T2, 1 at T3) show the instrument says 'not contained' for the right reason (uniqueness verified by brute force where N <= 26, so discrimination can be established only in cells with N in 18..26). The criterion needs >= 3 of 5 (|Z| = 1 verified and M-1 false) in one cell with N >= 18. Semi-regular cubic series give D_reg >= 5 at these N, so a large effect is expected.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Within each cell, arms rotate by seed (EQS4, EQS2, NULL-PROF, NULL-SHUF, PC-TRI, then EQS4-AA, EQS4-U, FE arms) so that no arm runs all first. Metrics are exact, so order cannot move them. It matters only for M-9.

seed_derivation.note:
seed = first 8 bytes of sha256(protocol_sha256 
 arm 
 instance 
 replicate), big-endian, with instance = cell_id and replicate = r. EQS4-U attempt a=0 is the EQS4 stream (arm EQS4, instance cell_id); attempt a>=1 uses arm EQS4-U with instance cell_id/a<a>. The curve and coset shifts use arm = 'SHARED' so matched arms share them. The substreams are HashRng sha256 counter-mode generators (block i = sha256(seed8 || label || i)), independent of any numpy or Python random version. Each row records both its arm seed and its SHARED seed.

instance_sampling.rule: Per (cell, r): curve and shifts from the SHARED substream, redrawn deterministically (counted) until every coset holds a curve point and a valid decomposition exists (feasibility only); planted points P_i uniform in Fb_i from the arm substream, with redraws on a partial sum O, R = O or x(R) = 0 counted. EQS2 or EQS4 with no valid decomposition is not_available (not a result). Z is enumerated algebraically. No selection on any closure outcome. EQS4-U selects on |Z| = 1 only.

blinding.how: Exact per-instance computations with frozen thresholds. Every non-containment carries a certificate re-checked by a Validator blind to code/. The analysis script is frozen before data. Controls are reported before targets are interpreted.

power.note: Counterexample search. One certified instance decides CL-counterexample, and no p-value is involved. For an all-contained outcome over R pooled decisive instances, the per-instance non-containment rate under the sampling rule is bounded below 3/R (rule of three, 95%), about 2-3% at the planned R of about 90-140. Per cell, 5 seeds bound only q < 0.45. This is not a power claim for any effect size.

primary.name: gb_contained_W4
primary.definition: True iff W_4 contains a degree-compatible Groebner basis of the instance ideal: d_GB(Z) <= 4 and dim W_4 = dim B_{<=4} - rank(ev_{Z,4}) (DER-3). For |Z| = 1: dim(W_4 cap B_{<=1}) = N and 1 not in W_4. When false, the type (L/G/D) is recorded.

primary.name: D_solve
primary.definition: Least D in 2..D_reached with the Groebner basis in W_D. Censored as '> D_reached' when not reached.

secondary.name: closure_series

secondary.name: plain_macaulay_contained

placement.memory_enforcement: resident-set watchdog (VmRSS, 10 GiB) in code/run.py is the binding memory limit; the supervisor's mandatory RLIMIT_AS is a loose 32768 MB virtual ceiling that is not a resource cap, and a kill at it is an infrastructure failure under SR-7 (DEC-20261106-36e212 RUL-3)

stopping_rules.rule: SR-1: fixtures F-1..F-8 run first. Any failure stops the run before any target instance. A not_covered verdict (for example F-6 without Sage) counts as a failure. F-5 against the producer-side checker is labelled not independent until the Validator checker exists.
SR-2: an instance over its per-instance-per-D cap is censored at that D. A censored M-1 is never false.
SR-3: skip an instance (not_attempted_budget) when (largest measured W_4 seconds) x (C4_new/C_meas)^3 exceeds the remaining budget minus 1200 s.
SR-4: any PC-TRI instance with M-1 false or D_solve > 3 stops the run as invalid.

SR-5: any EQS4-AA discrepancy in M-1, M-2, M-3, M-4 (iteration 0 included), M-5 or M-7 at any D on the adapted generators, a C-FE-EQ disagreement, or a failure of the F-4 raw-against-adapted check of W_D for D >= 3, stops the run as invalid.
SR-6: a non-contained EQS4 instance does not stop the run. It is re-run as EQS4-AA and certified, and the fixed plan continues.
SR-7: an RSS kill, crash or host failure ends that instance as failed_infrastructure (one retry). It is never negative evidence.
SR-8: a total of 43200 s ends the run. Completed cells are reported, the remainder not attempted.

invalidation_rules: IR-1: a descent check mismatch (generator against field-side S_3 at s and at 64 random points) invalidates the instance and suspends its cell
IR-2: Z enumeration disagreeing with brute force (targets N<=20, nulls N<=26) invalidates the instance
IR-3: a planted s that fails a generator, a v_i inside V, or coincident cosets invalidates the instance

IR-4: IR-4a a non-containment certificate rejected by the independent checker voids that M-1=false reading; IR-4b a certificate that is not emitted (size, wall or memory guard) or not yet checked leaves it unconfirmed. Either way the instance is reported as non_containment_uncertified, is never a counterexample and never a contained instance, and blocks the corroboration verdict until repaired or recorded as an impediment
IR-5: a dirty tree without per-file sha256 of the code that ran voids run provenance

decision_rule.text: Report controls first: fixtures, C-PC, C-AA-ENC, C-FE-EQ, then C-NULL. If any validity gate fails, the run is invalid. Otherwise CL-counterexample holds iff C-EQS4-ABS has >= 1 certified Type-L or Type-G M-1=false instance. CL-corroboration holds iff C-EQS4-ABS has every decisive instance contained and C-NULL shows NULL-PROF M-1=false on >= 3 of the 5 seeds of >= 1 completed cell with N >= 18, each counted seed having a verified single solution (|Z| = 1 by brute force for N <= 26) and M-1 false; only cells with N in 18..26 can carry this. An uncertified non-containment (IR-4) is not contained and blocks corroboration (verdict incomplete_censored, detail certificate_pending). Otherwise the outcome is inconclusive. What corroboration means is the operational form (degree 4 suffices), not Assumption 1 with the exact d_F = 2 (DER-5, DER-9).
decision_rule.threshold: one certified non-containment (CL-counterexample); zero non-containments, certified or not, plus null discrimination of >= 3/5 (|Z| = 1 verified and M-1 false) in a cell with N in 18..26 (CL-corroboration)
decision_rule.statistic: Per-instance exact M-1 and M-3. Counts of contained and not-contained per arm per cell.
decision_rule.interval: None for exact per-instance values. For pooled all-contained counts, the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on the per-instance non-containment rate.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Number of certified counterexamples, and per-cell D_solve distributions of EQS4 against NULL-PROF and EQS2

inadmissible: Reading a censored, skipped, killed or crashed instance as 'not contained'
Counting a non-containment whose certificate the independent checker has not accepted
Re-drawing seeds, curves or nulls after seeing closure outcomes, or adding seeds inside this version
Changing D_max, caps, the closure definition or the containment criterion after data without a filed amendment
Reporting an EQS2 (v = 0) result against Proposition 5
Stating any cost, speedup or deployed-curve consequence from any outcome
Using plain M_D non-containment as a counterexample (only W_D counts)
Treating a structurally forced C-FE-EQ agreement as evidence
Reading the trivial violation under the '>=' reading, or under the equality reading with d_F^eq = 2 (DER-5, DER-9), as this experiment's evidence
Reporting a non-containment without an accepted certificate as a counterexample, or as a contained instance (it is non_containment_uncertified)
Reading a null with undetermined_Z_unknown as 'not contained for the right reason'
Reporting containment at N >= 27 as certified (it is engine-decided; wdag is not attempted there)
